title: First principles
subtitle: 01 / Gravity & direction
description: Guide the orange ball into the green receiver. Place the two ramps to build a path through the air.
hint: Start with a gentle slope below the ball. Use the second ramp to continue the journey toward the receiver.

title: A little lightbulb moment
subtitle: 02 / Impact & power
description: Use a switch to turn on the signal lamp. Place it under the bowling ball, then connect the switch to the lamp.
hint: Select the switch, choose Connect, then click the lamp. The cable shows where the power will go.

title: Air mail
subtitle: 03 / Air & mass
description: Carry the little tennis ball into the receiver with a fan. Air pushes a light ball much more than a heavy one.
hint: Put the fan just to the left of the falling ball. Height matters: a short gust is often enough.

title: Spring forward
subtitle: 04 / Stored energy
description: Get the ball into the elevated receiver. Tilt a springboard to turn a downward fall into an upward journey.
hint: The spring launches along its top surface normal. Tilt it clockwise to send the ball right.

title: A different perspective
subtitle: 05 / Think in depth
description: The receiver is in front of the ball. Orbit the camera, change the work plane, and rotate a fan to move the ball through depth.
hint: The ball starts at depth -2; the receiver is at +2. Turn the fan 90° around its vertical axis. Right-drag to inspect.

title: The domino effect
subtitle: 06 / Chain reactions
description: Make the fixed end domino fall. Fill the gap with four dominoes.
hint: Start under the bowling ball. Neighbours must be less than a metre apart.

title: Spring-loaded signal
subtitle: 07 / Motion into power
description: Launch the ball onto the elevated switch and light the lamp.
hint: Tilt the spring clockwise. Remember the wire from switch to lamp.

title: A breath of electricity
subtitle: 08 / Motion into power
description: Use moving air to strike the switch and power the lamp.
hint: The fan's height controls how long the ball receives a push.

title: Cold start
subtitle: 09 / Causal machines
description: The fan starts off. Use the bowling ball to power it before the tennis ball falls past.
hint: A switch close beneath the bowling ball starts the fan early. Connect it to the fixed fan.

title: A little sidekick
subtitle: 10 / Round rebounds
description: Use the pinball bumper to bounce the orange ball into the receiver.
hint: The ball bounces away from the impact point. Put the bumper just left of the falling ball to send it right.

title: Bounce into depth
subtitle: 11 / Round rebounds
description: Send the ball across the workbench's depth with a round bumper.
hint: Orbit with Q/E to see the route. Offset the bumper toward the front so the ball rebounds toward the receiver behind it.

title: Return to sender
subtitle: 12 / Build a barrier
description: The fixed bumper launches the ball away from the basket. Build a wall that sends it back.
hint: Use the square resize icon. Make a tall, narrow barrier to the right of the bumper; the dashed boxes show its reach.

title: Build the rebound
subtitle: 13 / Build a barrier
description: Place both the launcher and its return wall to deliver the ball into the basket on the left.
hint: First offset the bumper slightly left of the falling ball. Then catch the rising flight with a tall wall to its right.

title: A turn for the better
subtitle: 14 / Electrical supply
description: Make the motor complete a full turn. It needs a battery, not an activation signal.
hint: Place a battery, select it and choose Connect. Click the motor, then Run.

title: Close the circuit
subtitle: 15 / Switched supply
description: The motor must wait for the falling ball to trigger its supply switch, then complete a turn.
hint: Place the switch under the ball. Connect battery to switch, then switch to motor. A switch controls electricity but does not create it.

title: Conveyor courier
subtitle: 16 / Mechanical drive
description: Carry the ball on a motor-driven conveyor. A belt needs rotation, not an activation signal.
hint: Place the conveyor beneath the ball. Connect battery to motor, then motor to conveyor.

title: Pass the rotation
subtitle: 17 / Mechanical drive
description: Use the high conveyor's output pulley to drive the delivery conveyor below.
hint: Wire battery to motor. Belt the motor to the high conveyor, then connect that conveyor to your delivery belt.

title: The other way round
subtitle: 18 / Reverse transmission
description: The basket is to the left. Reverse the drive so the conveyor carries the ball back toward it.
hint: Wire battery to motor, then belt motor to reverse transmission and transmission to conveyor. Its paired wheels turn in opposite directions.

title: A helping weight
subtitle: 19 / Ropes and loads
description: Lift the small load into the overhead switch to light the lamp. A heavier weight can pull it upward.
hint: Place the larger weight high under the right pulley. Connect small load → left pulley → right pulley → large weight, then switch → lamp. Rope length is set when you connect.

title: Around the corner
subtitle: 20 / Route a rope
description: The counterweight belongs in the front depth lane. Add a pulley above it and route the rope back to the small load.
hint: Place the second pulley above the large weight. Connect both pulleys into one continuous rope with a load at each end; a loose end cannot lift anything.

title: A little sunshine
subtitle: 21 / Light into electricity
description: Use the flashlight to supply the motor through a solar panel. The falling ball presses the torch's button.
hint: Put the panel in front of the cream lens, with blue cells facing the torch. Connect panel to motor; four gold meter marks mean enough light.

title: Out of the shade
subtitle: 22 / Light and obstacles
description: The wooden wall blocks the flashlight. Find a lit position for the panel and turn the motor.
hint: Keep the panel on the flashlight side of the wall, facing the lens. Wires carry electricity around obstacles, but light cannot pass through them.

title: Wait for it
subtitle: 23 / Delayed commands
description: Light the lamp only after the delay box finishes its countdown.
hint: Connect switch → delay → lamp. A trigger starts the one-second countdown; further triggers are ignored until Reset.

title: A later sunrise
subtitle: 24 / Timing and power
description: Wait for the countdown before lighting the torch and turning the motor.
hint: Connect switch → delay → torch, then panel → motor. The delay sends a command, while the lit solar panel supplies electricity.

title: Two deliveries
subtitle: 25 / Parallel machines
description: Catch both balls, one with ramps and one with air. The receivers are in separate depth planes.
hint: Work on one depth plane at a time; both goals must finish in the same run.

title: Bounce and roll
subtitle: 26 / Parallel machines
description: Complete the ramp route and the elevated spring catch.
hint: The spring route and ramp route use different heights and depth planes.

title: Air and belt
subtitle: 27 / Parallel machines
description: Deliver one ball with air and carry the other on a conveyor.
hint: The fan acts at a distance; the conveyor only transports a ball touching its top.

title: Catch and signal
subtitle: 28 / Parallel machines
description: Catch the orange ball and activate the lamp in the other plane.
hint: Use two ramps for the catch; place and wire the switch under the bowling ball.

title: Wind and dominoes
subtitle: 29 / Parallel machines
description: Catch the tennis ball and topple the end domino.
hint: The four dominoes bridge one plane while the fan works in the other.

title: Powered post
subtitle: 30 / Dependencies
description: Start the cold fan, deliver its ball, and complete the separate ramp route.
hint: Place the power switch near its trigger ball so air is ready in time.

title: Spring and chain
subtitle: 31 / Dependencies
description: Land the spring-launched ball and finish the domino chain.
hint: The spring needs a tilt; the dominoes need close spacing.

title: Two signals
subtitle: 32 / Dependencies
description: Light both lamps, using a ramp path and a spring path.
hint: Every fixed switch must be wired to a lamp; completing only one is not enough.

title: Belt and signal
subtitle: 33 / Dependencies
description: Deliver the conveyor ball while air drives the other ball onto a switch.
hint: Separate capture from activation: one goal needs a settled ball, the other an impact.

title: Start and topple
subtitle: 34 / Dependencies
description: Power the cold fan, catch its ball, and finish the domino chain.
hint: The fan needs a wire; the dominoes propagate through proximity, without wires.

title: Deep routes
subtitle: 35 / Spatial reasoning
description: Guide two balls along depth-oriented ramp routes.
hint: Orbit the camera. Turn the ramps 90 degrees, then tilt them along their local slope.

title: Cross breezes
subtitle: 36 / Spatial reasoning
description: Two fans must send their balls in opposite depth directions.
hint: Use the green rotation ring to turn each fan. Keep each gust in its own X lane.

title: Deep springs
subtitle: 37 / Spatial reasoning
description: Launch two balls through depth into elevated receivers.
hint: Rotate each spring around Y, then use the rotation rings to set its launch tilt.

title: Spatial signals
subtitle: 38 / Spatial reasoning
description: Send a rolling ball and an airborne ball onto switches in depth-oriented lanes.
hint: Both switches need wiring. Watch the goal positions while orbiting.

title: Three deliveries
subtitle: 39 / Three-stage workshop
description: Complete three captures with ramps, air, and a spring.
hint: Use depth planes -3, 0, and +3; tune each route before combining the run.

title: Triple signal
subtitle: 40 / Three-stage workshop
description: Light three lamps using ramps, a spring, and air.
hint: Each fixed switch needs a cable. The ball paths occupy three depth planes.

title: Cold front
subtitle: 41 / Three-stage workshop
description: Start a cold fan while a ramp route and a spring route deliver their balls.
hint: The powered lane has two required events: activation and capture.

title: Chain mail
subtitle: 42 / Three-stage workshop
description: Catch the wind-driven ball, deliver the conveyor ball, and topple the end domino.
hint: Dominoes need a continuous bridge; the other parts belong to the two delivery lanes.

title: Bounce mail
subtitle: 43 / Three-stage workshop
description: Combine a spring catch, a wind-triggered lamp, and a domino chain.
hint: The three goals use capture, electrical activation, and physical propagation.

title: Relay workshop
subtitle: 44 / Three-stage workshop
description: Start the cold fan, light the ramp-triggered lamp, and complete the chain.
hint: Solve the early power trigger first, then the ramp geometry, then domino spacing.

title: Double cold start
subtitle: 45 / Master workshop
description: Start a stopped conveyor and a cold fan, then finish a spring catch in a third lane.
hint: Wire one trigger switch to the belt and another to the fan. The fan needs power before its ball falls past.

title: Triple chain
subtitle: 46 / Master workshop
description: Finish three separate domino chains with twelve movable dominoes.
hint: Keep every gap below one metre and keep the three chains in their own depth planes.

title: Signals and chain
subtitle: 47 / Master workshop
description: Light the ramp and spring lamps while a third lane topples its end domino.
hint: Do not confuse the fixed switches with receivers: impact is enough, but wiring is required.

title: Cold signals
subtitle: 48 / Master workshop
description: Power the fan and capture its ball, then light both motion-triggered lamps.
hint: The fan must start early; the other cables may be connected before running.

title: Depth delivery office
subtitle: 49 / Master workshop
description: Complete three differently powered deliveries along depth-oriented lanes.
hint: Use X lanes -3, 0, and +3. Part positions differ in depth even where the front view overlaps.

title: Depth telegraph
subtitle: 50 / Final workshop
description: Light three lamps using depth-oriented rolling, spring, and wind routes.
hint: Orbit before placing; use the switch positions as the ends of each route.

title: Double bridge
subtitle: 51 / Final workshop
description: Build two domino bridges and complete the central conveyor delivery.
hint: Allocate four dominoes to each outside lane and the conveyor to the centre.

title: Bridges and signal
subtitle: 52 / Final workshop
description: Complete two domino bridges and light the central spring-triggered lamp.
hint: The lamp needs the fixed switch wired; the bridges need physical continuity.

title: Cold bridges
subtitle: 53 / Final workshop
description: Two domino chains frame a cold-start fan delivery. Complete all four objectives.
hint: Start the fan with the nearby trigger ball, then use the eight dominoes to bridge both outside gaps.

title: The grand contraption
subtitle: 54 / Final workshop
description: Complete the ramp signal, conveyor signal, and domino chain; all three must succeed in one run.
hint: Build and test each lane. The final machine needs two slopes, a conveyor delivery, four dominoes, and both signal wires.
